# Twnzl 1499753 — vendor files

Source: https://www.printables.com/model/1499753-ender3-v3-se-raspberry-pi-zero-2w-with-camera-moun

Author: Twnzl. License: CC BY-SA 4.0.
Remix of bioxz (Ender-3 V3 SE Pi Zero & Camera Mount) and
DotNetWorker (Pi Zero snapfit case).

`piZeroEnderMountV3C.stl` is the stock file (Pi Zero 2W + Arducam CS B0032).

Shop remake of the camera interface: `../../twnzl_y_mount_m12.scad`
(36×36 M12 / 28.8 grid / 17 mm lens). Do not boolean this STL — it is not
CGAL-valid in OpenSCAD 2021.01.
